title: Boeing F-15EX St. Louis production line: Air Force Receives First F-15EX Aircraft
summary: The Air Force recorded receipt of the first F-15EX aircraft from Boeing's St. Louis production line. Phase 56E entity use: The cumulative delivery sequence is retained alongside planned rate, quality, and strike constraints without inferring one production cause.
key_findings: The record establishes the product and facility baseline for the delivery series.
Entity layer: St. Louis F-15EX production and delivery sequence.
Compatibility boundary: Same line and product; milestone counts and the strike interval establish sequence, not a counterfactual.
why_it_matters: The record supports one or more layers of the second-cohort panel, driver-and-constraint dossier, and alternative-explanation test.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves a stable second-cohort entity identity.
Keeps attribution and the observation denominator visible.
Connects the same entity vertically across three evidence layers.
evidence_limits: First-delivery timing does not establish recurring production rate, quality, cost, labor, or acceptance performance.
Air Force operational account and independent GAO program context.
No causal effect, ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
